jobs.occupation: Junior Structural Analysis Engineer – Marine Technology
jobs.description:
Work with large-scale moving structures where structural analysis, advanced mechanics and material engineering come together. Help develop innovative wind-powered technology for more energy-efficient shipping, taking your calculations and design solutions all the way to full-scale applications. As part of a small engineering team, you'll have the freedom to influence the product and take ownership from day one. Whether you're a recent graduate or have a few years of experience, you'll get to tackle complex engineering challenges while developing your technical expertise.
About the Role
We are looking for a Junior Structural Analysis Engineer to join an innovative technology company in Stockholm, developing large-scale mechanical systems for more sustainable shipping. The company combines advanced engineering, mechanical design and material technology to create solutions that harness wind power and reduce fuel consumption in the maritime industry.
In this role, you will focus on developing and improving existing products, making complex mechanical structures lighter, more efficient and easier to manufacture. Your work will range from detailed structural calculations and smaller design improvements to evaluating major design changes and new technical concepts.
You will work closely with mechanical engineers and other specialists in a small, collaborative development team. The products involve large moving structures exposed to demanding environmental conditions, where loads, movement, material properties and mechanical functionality must all be considered.
What makes this opportunity particularly exciting is the ability to influence the actual product. Your calculations and technical assessments will directly contribute to design decisions, and you will have the opportunity to follow your work through development, manufacturing and testing. With a high level of responsibility and freedom, you will play an active role in shaping both the technical solutions and the final product.
Key Responsibilities
Perform structural calculations and analyses of large-scale mechanical structures and components.
Analyze and optimize designs with regard to strength, weight, functionality and manufacturability.
Evaluate how different loads, movements and material properties affect structural performance.
Prepare calculation reports and technical documentation to support engineering decisions.
Work with calculation and simulation tools, including opportunities to develop and improve analysis methods.
Evaluate design alternatives and contribute to technical solutions in close collaboration with mechanical engineers.
Participate in product development, from early concepts and design iterations to final solutions and testing.

About You
A Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Naval Architecture, Engineering Mechanics, Marine Engineering or a related field.
A solid understanding of structural mechanics, strength of materials and mechanical behavior under different loads.
Experience with structural calculations and analysis, gained through academic projects or professional work.
An interest in mechanical design and understanding how individual components contribute to the performance of a complete system.
Good communication skills in English.

It is considered an advantage if you have experience with finite element analysis (FEA), ANSYS, Python or similar engineering calculation tools. Experience with large mechanical structures, moving systems, hydraulics, steel or composite materials is also valuable. A background in marine engineering, offshore, heavy industry or working with DNV standards would be particularly relevant.
As a person, you are self-driven, curious and comfortable taking responsibility for your own work. You enjoy getting into the technical details of calculations while maintaining an understanding of the bigger picture. You take initiative, explore different solutions and are motivated by seeing your engineering work turn into real, functioning products.
About the employment
This is a consultancy assignment, which means that you will initially be employed by Friday. The shared intention of Friday and our client is for you to transition to direct employment with the client after 12 months.
Applicants who already have the legal right to work in Sweden will be prioritized. Work permit sponsorship may be considered in exceptional cases.

Carrying out light technical maintenance and installations at customer sites

Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.

Your role

Defence and security are changing fast. At Saab Naval Combat Systems, we are investing for growth and adapting to this shift. To succeed, we need to maintain focus and cohesion at system level across the solutions we deliver to our customers.
As Head of Systems Design, you will lead a department of highly skilled specialists within Technical Project Management, Systems Engineering, Configuration Management and Safety Engineering. The department is responsible for overall system design, ensuring that architecture, requirements and technical solutions are managed throughout the product lifecycle.
The organization currently consists of seven managers and their teams. You will also have a dotted-line responsibility for a team in Germany, playing a key role in strengthening collaboration and harmonizing ways of working across our Swedish and German operations. As a member of the Product Unit management team, you report to the Head of PU Combat Systems.
Your main task will be to initiate and drive a transformation journey for our Systems Design department. Today, we have many parallel projects and a strong delivery focus, but we see great potential to work more efficiently and strategically product oriented. 
Key responsibilities:
Lead, coach and develop seven line managers and their teams.
Set the strategic direction for Systems Design and translate it into clear priorities and actions.
Drive increased reuse of designs, architectures and technical solutions across projects.
Establish common processes, methods and tools within Systems Engineering, Configuration Management, Safety Engineering and Technical Project Management.
Strengthen ownership of engineering processes, methods and tools within the line organization.
Improve onboarding and knowledge sharing to reduce dependency on key individuals and accelerate productivity.
Ensure consistency and quality in the application of methods, tools and processes across projects.
Balance operational delivery with long-term capability development by acting as a bridge between projects and the line organization.
Strengthen collaboration and leverage synergies across our Swedish, German, Finnish and Australian operations.
Contribute actively to the Engineering Management Team through strategic planning, competence development and resource management.

Your profile

As a person, you are clear, trustworthy and engaging. You create participation, set direction and dare to challenge established ways of working - always with the business, the customer and your people in focus.
We believe you have:
Solid experience from systems development in a complex, regulated or safety-critical environment.
Proven leadership experience, preferably with responsibility for managers and senior experts.
Experience of driving change and improvement work in engineering organisations, for example around process development, reuse/standardisation or CM.
An understanding for or experience with running large and complex projects.
A structured and analytical working style, with the ability to see the big picture and at the same time understand operational challenges.
Strong communication and collaboration skills in English, both spoken and written. Knowledge of Swedish and/or German is an advantage but not a requirement.

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be a part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.
Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here.

Join our Technology Development team in Svedala and help develop simulation models that improve the performance of our crushing solutions. In this position, you combine analytical work with hands-on verification and testing, while building a detailed understanding of our machine systems and their functionality.  
About your job
As a CAE Engineer, you design, implement and use simulation models to support the development and optimization of our machine systems. Your work ranges from physical modelling and analysis to practical model verification, testing and measurement activities, with close connections to product development.  
Job responsibilities  
Design, implement and use simulation models across different physical domains.  
Develop functionality that supports the design, optimization and improvement of machine systems. 
Verify and validate simulation models through testing and measurement activities. 
Develop algorithms and code related to simulation and modelling.  
Collaborate with design engineers on product improvements and new concepts. 
Contribute to developing our CAE methods, tools and ways of working. 

 
Location and flexibility 
This position is based in Svedala, where Division Crushing Solutions has its global development center for crushers.
Your profile
We’re looking for someone with a strong technical and analytical foundation and an interest in physical modelling and simulation. Experience in developing and validating simulation models enables you to move confidently between theoretical analysis and practical verification.  
Your background includes 
A Master of Science or higher degree in physics, mathematics or mechanical engineering.  
Experience developing simulation models in different physical domains.  
Experience verifying and validating simulation models. 
Experience in algorithm development and coding.  
It’s beneficial if you have experience in testing, as well as experience leading projects or teams.  

You enjoy working with new technology and approaching complex challenges in a structured, analytical and pragmatic way. Collaboration comes naturally to you, and your communication skills help you work effectively across functions, cultures and with both internal and external stakeholders. Just as importantly, you contribute to a positive team spirit.  
The team
You join a small and agile Technology Development team, giving you the opportunity to influence methods, tools and ways of working within CAE. Cross-functional collaboration is a natural part of your day, connecting you with colleagues and stakeholders across our organization.
Our culture
Sandvik is so much more than an engineering group in the manufacturing industry. We’re a global company with many opportunities for personal and professional development – and great benefits. We’ve been an employer to trust for 160 years, and our reward philosophy states that remuneration and other employment conditions should align with local market practice, be competitive, and reflect responsibility and performance. We have a clear objective of being a leader within digital solutions in our industry and we focus on growing our digital customer offering. To get there, we work towards an even more diverse and inclusive organization – because we’re sure that differences improve Sandvik's business and creates a culture of innovation.
